description: Driver-app: wire up EarningsScreen to real API, add RatePassengerScreen, update ActiveTripScreen to navigate to RatePassengerScreen on completion, and show live driver rating in ProfileScreen and HomeScreen. Independent of FEAT-002 (passenger-app UI); depends on FEAT-001 for the API methods on DriverAPI.ts.
steps: 1. Rewrite /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/EarningsScreen.tsx. Currently it calls DriverAPI.getEarnings() which hits '/driver/earnings' (a non-existent endpoint on the gateway). Replace the DriverAPI.getEarnings() call with DriverAPI.getEarningsSummary() (added in FEAT-001 step 6) which hits '/earnings/summary'. Keep the same UI component structure (period selector, breakdown card, summary card) and the same ThemeContext/useTranslation pattern. Add a history section below the existing 'All Time' card: fetch DriverAPI.getEarningsHistory(selectedPeriod) when selectedPeriod changes; render a FlatList of EarningsHistoryItem rows showing date, passenger name, net amount, payment method. Add a 'Withdraw Earnings' TouchableOpacity button at the bottom (placeholder: Alert 'Withdrawal coming soon — contact support'). No new npm packages.

2. Create /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/RatePassengerScreen.tsx. This is a new file. It receives navigation params: { tripId: string; passengerId: string; passengerName: string; fare: number }. It shows: title 'Rate Passenger', passenger name with initial avatar, 5 interactive star buttons (same pattern as passenger-app RatingScreen — TouchableOpacity per star), an optional comment TextInput, and a 'Submit Rating' button. On submit call DriverAPI.submitRating({ trip_id, ratee_id: passengerId, rating, review: comment }) then navigate back to Home tab (navigation.reset to Main root or navigation.navigate('HomeMain')). On error show Alert. Style with useTheme() following the existing trip screen pattern (see ActiveTripScreen.tsx for reference).

3. Update /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/ActiveTripScreen.tsx. When trip status becomes 'completed' (inside the confirmPayment / handlePaymentConfirm flow where setTrip({ ...trip, status: 'completed' }) is called), instead of just dismissing the modal, navigate to RatePassengerScreen with params { tripId: route.params.tripId, passengerId: route.params.passengerId ?? '', passengerName: trip.passengerName, fare: trip.fare }. Add passengerId to HomeStackParamList['ActiveTrip'] as optional string. The navigation call should be navigation.navigate('RatePassenger', {...}) — add RatePassenger to HomeStackParamList.

4. Register RatePassengerScreen in /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx. Add 'RatePassenger' to HomeStackParamList type: { tripId: string; passengerId: string; passengerName: string; fare: number }. Import RatePassengerScreen from '../screens/trip/RatePassengerScreen'. Add a HomeStack.Screen for 'RatePassenger' component={RatePassengerScreen} with options={{ title: 'Rate Passenger' }}.

5. Update /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.tsx to display the driver's rating. Add a useEffect on mount that calls DriverAPI.getDriverRating(user?.id ?? '') (using getDriverRating added in FEAT-001 step 6) and stores result in local state driverRating. In the profileHeader section, below the phone number, add a row showing '⭐ {driverRating.average.toFixed(1)} ({driverRating.count} ratings)' — only rendered if count > 0. Keep all existing layout and styling intact.

6. Update /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/HomeScreen.tsx to show today's earnings from the new API. The loadData function already calls DriverAPI.getEarnings() and sets setTodayEarnings(earnings.today). Change that call to DriverAPI.getEarningsSummary() — the EarningsSummary interface has the same shape so no other changes needed. Also fetch driver rating: call DriverAPI.getDriverRating(user?.id) after loadData and display it in the home screen header card (the card that shows todayEarnings). Add a small '⭐ X.X' badge next to the driver name or status label. Requires importing useAuth to get user.id — add const { user } = useAuth().
acceptance_criteria: driver-app EarningsScreen loads data from /earnings/summary (getEarningsSummary) and shows history from /earnings/history.
RatePassengerScreen.tsx exists in src/screens/trip/, compiles without errors, submits to /ratings via DriverAPI.submitRating.
ActiveTripScreen navigates to RatePassengerScreen on trip completion instead of staying on a completed screen.
RatePassenger is registered in HomeStackParamList and HomeNavigator.
ProfileScreen shows driver rating fetched from DriverAPI.getDriverRating.
HomeScreen uses getEarningsSummary() instead of getEarnings().
